```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(showtext)
library(ggimage)

conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(),
                       dbdir = "data.db")

DBI::dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
# add special fonts
font_add_google(name = "Rye", family = "rye") 
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
herd_weight_db <- tbl(conn, "herd_weight")
herd_weight_db

maternal_parentage_db <- tbl(conn, "maternal_parentage")
maternal_parentage_db

sex_count_db <- tbl(conn, "sex_count")
sex_count_db
```

```{r}
table1 <- dbGetQuery(conn, 
"SELECT mp.DamTag,
    -- Count the distinct 'CalfTag' matched to each 'DamTag', as num_calves column.
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.CalfTag) AS num_calves,
    -- Average 'AnimalWeight' from table hw.
    AVG(hw.AnimalWeight) AS avg_calf_weight
-- Use table mp (maternal_parentage).
FROM maternal_parentage mp
-- Join table hw (herd_weight) on 'CalfTag' table mp and 'AnimalCode' table hw columns.
JOIN herd_weight hw ON mp.CalfTag = hw.AnimalCode
    -- where 'AnimalYOB' in table hw and 'RecYear' in table hw are the same.
    AND hw.AnimalYOB = hw.RecYear
-- Group by 'DamTag' in table mp.
GROUP BY mp.DamTag
-- Order by 'num_calves' from highest to lowest.
ORDER BY num_calves DESC
-- Show the top 10 dams to produce the most calves.
LIMIT 10;")
table1
```


```{r}
table2 <- dbGetQuery(conn, 
"SELECT mp.DamTag,
    -- Count the distinct 'CalfTag' matched to each 'DamTag', as num_calves column.
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.CalfTag) AS num_calves,
    -- Average 'AnimalWeight' as avg_calf_weight.
    AVG(calf_weight.AnimalWeight) AS avg_calf_weight,
    -- Average 'AnimalWeight' as avg_dam_weight.
    AVG(dam_weight.AnimalWeight) AS avg_dam_weight
-- Use maternal_parentage as mp.
FROM maternal_parentage mp
-- Join calf_weight to table mp, on table mp 'CalfTag' column and table calf_weight 'AnimalCode' column.
JOIN herd_weight calf_weight ON mp.CalfTag = calf_weight.AnimalCode
    -- Where 'AnimalYOB' and 'RecYear' of calf_weight are the same.
    AND calf_weight.AnimalYOB = calf_weight.RecYear
-- Join dam_weight to table mp, on table mp on 'DamTag' column and table dam_weight 'AnimalCode' column.
JOIN herd_weight dam_weight ON mp.DamTag = dam_weight.AnimalCode
-- Group by table mp 'DamTag' column.
GROUP BY mp.DamTag
-- Order by 'num_calves' column from highest to lowest.
ORDER BY num_calves DESC
-- Show the top 10 dams to produce the most calves.
LIMIT 10;")
table2
```


```{r}
showtext.auto(enable = TRUE)

num_calves <- table2 %>%
  mutate(DamTag = as.character(DamTag)) %>%
  arrange(desc(num_calves)) %>%
  mutate(DamTag = factor(DamTag, levels = DamTag)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = DamTag)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = avg_calf_weight, color = "Average Calf Weight"),
                 linewidth = 2, 
                 position = position_nudge(x = -0.25)) +
  geom_image(aes(y = avg_calf_weight, image = "images/calf.png"), 
             size = 0.1,
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.3)) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = avg_calf_weight, label = num_calves),
           color = "black", 
           size = 4.5, 
           fontface = "bold",
           family = "rye",
           position = position_nudge(x = -0.25, y = 10)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = avg_dam_weight, color = "Average Bison Cow Weight"),
                 linewidth = 2, 
                 position = position_nudge(x = 0.22)) +
  geom_image(aes(y = avg_dam_weight, image = "images/mama.png"), 
             size = 0.1,
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Average Calf Weight" = "#C49BBB",
                                "Average Bison Cow Weight"  = "#784F41")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Weight (lbs)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(family = "rye"),
    legend.text = element_text(family = "rye"),
    axis.text = element_text(family = "rye"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

num_calves

ggsave("images/num_calves.pdf", 
       plot = num_calves,
       height = 7,
       width = 10,
       dpi = 300)
ggsave("images/num_calves.png", 
       plot = num_calves,
       height = 7,
       width = 10)
```
